Introduction

Yuki is a Japanese rapper, dancer, singer, and actress under RBW. She is a member of the girl group PURPLE KISS, with whom she debuted on March 15, 2021, with the mini album “INTO VIOLET”, and its title track “Ponzona”.

On April 24, 2023, she participated in Mnet' survival show Queendom Puzzle, where she finished in 3rd place, earning her a spot in the project girl group EL7Z UP. She made her debut with the group on September 14, 2023, with the release of their first and only mini album “7+UP”, and its title track “CHEEKY”.
